review_method: Independent full-source static inspection plus fixture report inspection; no production execution and no redundant fixture rerun
not_authority: This is technical safety review, not Gate B, writer exclusion, deployment authorization, current Preview PASS, or proof of actual server execution.

checks.self_pin_and_isolated_python: PASS: requires python -I, exact SHA256 and bounded seconds1..180
checks.no_production_code_or_business_sql_write: PASS: no source mutation, imports of private modules, subprocess, process kill, service control, SQL mutation or network operation
checks.output_scope: PASS: new direct child of existing root/autopilot_inbox/cloud,0700; report files0600; O_EXCL refusal preserves unknown old outcome
checks.source_and_output_nofollow: PASS: directory ancestors opened O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW; source regular-file checks with fstat/named-stamp readback; output O_NOFOLLOW/O_EXCL
checks.sqlite_reader: PASS within declared semantics: URI mode=ro,query_only,short BEGIN read snapshots,0.5s busy timeout,progress-handler deadline,quick_check; normal reader lock/WAL-SHM coordination is explicitly disclosed
checks.export_minimization: PASS: only6public fields of published rows, private cars/audit/schema as digests, source/routing as hashes; optional UTF8 core public HTML only; no private source bytes/DB copy
checks.bounded_capture: PASS:180s hard signal/progress bound for observation;100000files,12GiB perinventory,512MiB/file,8MiB/coreHTML,64MiB captures,1millionrows; two passes must agree
checks.drift_and_unknown_outcome: PASS: incomplete/error/drift marked PARTIAL_NOT_ACCEPTED, existing output refuses rerun, no automatic retry or write replay
checks.fixture_evidence: 5/5 author fixtures PASS against exact reviewedSHA; isolated only; independently inspected report,not rerun

limitations: 180s signal applies to collection; final serialization/fsync/export runs after alarm cancellation. File and capture byte limits bound output size, but180s is not a guaranteed total process walltime.

SQLite itself opens its path after a no-follow precheck. Python sqlite3 does not receive an O_NOFOLLOW descriptor; before/after inode verification plus second snapshot detects ordinary replacement. Do not characterize this as an adversarial race-proof SQLite open.
Whole-tree hashing may perform up to24GiB of reads across two passes and contend for disk within the bounded window. No forced writer exclusion or process alteration is authorized by this review.
Double-read equality is endpoint stability only. Static HTTP mapping/current servedURLs are not freshly observed; script explicitly states this.
If execution times out or connection drops, inspect the unique output and process outcome before any new invocation. Never reuse/overwrite output or infer PASS from partial files.
